name: the garden of eternal smiles
source:
>You wake up.

>Cotton candy clouds drift across your room.

>The sky is crystalline beyond your window.

>It’s a beautiful day.

 . . . 

>Welcome to paradise.

[From [url=https://rhinobeetl.itch.io/the-garden]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
>你醒了。

>棉花糖云飘过你的房间。

>窗外的天空是水晶般的。

>这是美好的一天。。。。

>欢迎来到天堂。

[来自[url=https://rhinobeetl.itch.io/the-garden]itch.io[/url]]
